items.q: Is AI-SPEIS really personalized to my resume?
items.a: Yes! AI-SPEIS uses advanced LLM models to parse your skills, projects, and experiences from your PDF resume to generate tailored interview questions.

items.q: Do I need to install any software?
items.a: No. AI-SPEIS runs 100% in your browser. All you need is a microphone and an internet connection.

items.q: What languages does the Coding Sandbox support?
items.a: It supports C, C++, Java, C#, Python, and JavaScript/Node.js powered by a fast Judge0 Sandbox backend.

items.q: Can I cancel my Pro subscription anytime?
items.a: Absolutely. You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time from your Account Settings.
